joshua.24.p1.b1.text: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

joshua.24.p1.b2.text: Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.

joshua.24.p1.b3.text: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,

joshua.24.p1.b4.text: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. … Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

joshua.24.p2.b1.text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.

joshua.24.p2.b2.text: the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

joshua.24.p2.b3.text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them.

joshua.24.p2.b4.text: Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

joshua.24.p3.b1.text: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand …

joshua.24.p3.b2.text: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

joshua.24.p3.b3.text: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.

joshua.24.p4.b1.text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you … and I delivered them into your hand.

joshua.24.p4.b2.text: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.

joshua.24.p4.b3.text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.

joshua.24.p5.b1.text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

joshua.24.p5.b2.text: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve …

joshua.24.p5.b3.text: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!

joshua.24.p6.b1.text: Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

joshua.24.p6.b2.text: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery … He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

joshua.24.p6.b3.text: You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God …

joshua.24.p6.b4.text: No! … We will serve the LORD!

joshua.24.p7.b1.text: You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.

joshua.24.p7.b3.text: Now, therefore … get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.

joshua.24.p7.b4.text: We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.

joshua.24.p8.b1.text: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God.

joshua.24.p8.b2.text: Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.

joshua.24.p8.b3.text: You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us …

joshua.24.p8.b4.text: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

joshua.24.p9.b1.text: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.

joshua.24.p9.b2.text: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim …

joshua.24.p9.b3.text: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.

joshua.24.p9.b4.text: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
